name: Deep Imaskari
traitsHtml:
Photoresistant.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Radiant damage.

Resourceful.

You gain Heroic Inspiration|XPHB whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Unluminescent.

As an action, you can will the crystals protruding from your body to glow with Unlight. You shed Bright Light|XPHB in a 5-foot radius until you use an action to stop the effect. Your crystals stop glowing if you die or have the Unconscious condition.

Aura of Unlight.

When you reach character level 3, you can use a Bonus Action|XPHB to create an Aura of Unlight that sheds Bright Light|XPHB in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from you.

Choose one of the options below each time you create the aura; the aura lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required), and once you create this aura, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB:

  • Abjuring Unlight.

    You and your allies in the aura gain a bonus to AC equal to half your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus (round down).

  • Brilliant Unlight.

    Creatures other than your allies that start their turn within the Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus) or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

  • Corrupting Unlight.

    When you deal damage to a creature with an attack or a spell, you can change the damage type to Radiant. Additionally, you can roll one of your unexpended Hit Point Dice|XPHB and deal extra Radiant damage equal to the number rolled. That die is then expended.

name: Drider
traitsHtml:
Arachnid Build.

You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

Spells of the Spider Queen.

You know the Dancing Lights cantrip. When you reach character level 3, you always have the Faerie Fire spell prepared. When you reach character level 5, you always have the Web spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select this species).

Spider Climb.

You have a Climb Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB. When you reach character level 3, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings while leaving your hands free.

Web Walker.

You ignore movement restrictions caused by webs, and you know the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

name: Kuo-Toa
traitsHtml:
Amphibious.

You can breathe both air and water. Additionally, you have a Swim Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB.

Slippery.

You have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws to avoid or end the Grappled and Restrained conditions.

Deific Manifestation.

You always have the Find Familiar spell prepared and can cast it without material components. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: Homunculus or Myconid Sprout. The familiar's creature type is Celestial. Additionally, your familiar's form is a divine blend of multiple creatures. When you cast this spell, choose a second form from the available options. Your familiar gains one action, Reaction|XPHB, or trait from that second form.

name: Myconid
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

Telepathy.

You have telepathy|XPHB with a range of 30 feet.

Rapport Spores.

As an action, you expel spores in a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from yourself. Creatures in the area with an Intelligence score of 2 or higher that aren't Constructs, Elementals, or Undead gain telepathy|XPHB within a range of 30 feet for 1 hour. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Skill Meld.

When you finish a Long Rest|XPHB, you can perform a melding ritual to share knowledge and experiences. When you do so, choose up to six allies (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of yourself to partake in the ritual and a skill proficiency that at least one participant has proficiency in. The chosen creatures each have proficiency in that skill until they finish a Long Rest|XPHB.
